item.title: Grundy County Commission approves 2026 budget with planned shortfall
item.description: The Grundy County Commission formally adopted the 2026 county budget on Jan. 27, projecting total revenues of $7,240,401.75 and expenditures of $7,727,818.96. The spending plan anticipates a deficit of approximately $487,417.21. The county began the year with carryover funds totaling $4,172,557.64 and is expected to close the fiscal year with an estimated balance of $3,685,140.43.
